title: Penn-Plax VacGroom Pet Grooming Attachment Kit

comparisons.notes: Matching VacGroom kit. Price and Add availability cross-checked using Walmart’s publicly indexed brand listing updated October 30; interactive checkout was not verified.

writeup: The VacGroom kit includes a grooming tool, three combs and an extension hose for use with a compatible vacuum. Woot’s $8.22 is 72% below the $29.67 price in Walmart’s public listing, rather than the much higher Woot reference price. It is most useful if your pet tolerates a vacuum and your machine has a compatible circular intake.
notes: This is an attachment kit, not a vacuum. Check the adapter dimensions and introduce the tool gradually. Walmart’s interactive product page required human verification, so the comparison uses its public search-accessible listing; confirm stock and price before buying.
